我的朋友凯特(My Friend Kate): 围绕自然环境的A1短文:介绍本的日常、喜好与河岸。
My friend Kate is very kind. Kate often helps me with math. The river bank is not far from my home. Also, the robot can play chess — wonderful!
Kate likes noodles too. Ben's favorite subject is math. We often go to the library together. What's more, we ate fresh corn from the farm.
Ben drinks water every morning. I am happy every day. I like my life very much.
